name: Maud of the Grief House, Who Sings Before
role: A keener who sings the death of anyone who will die within the week, and cannot stop herself
knowledge: Every song she has sung, and whether it came true (it always has)
The names of the dead of the Feeling Coast for three generations
Something about the player that she has not sung yet, and is trying not to
wants: To sing once for someone who lives through it
fears: Her own name in her own song.
That her singing is the cause, not the warning.
appearance: A grey-haired woman in mourning black, grey-faced, with a voice that makes people stop in the street. She keeps her hand over her mouth when she is not singing.
voiceHints: Hushed, halting, apologetic, until she sings, and then she does not stop until it is done.

reactsToReputation.any: looks at you for a long time

abilities.why: she feels the death before it comes
she carries the names of the lost
she sits with the ones she sang for

physicality: Slight, hunched, and very quiet. What catches the eye: people she walks past stop and look at their hands.
questSeeds: She has begun to sing for someone the player knows. She comes to find them, begging them to prove her wrong.
The Threnodists say a keener's song can be answered: sing back loud enough and the death changes its mind. No one has done it in living memory.
storyRule: The Threnodist tale: a keener's song is a warning, not a sentence. Answered with a true song of defiance, sung by the one it names, it can be turned. It has not happened in her lifetime.
gear: a lock of hair for every song that came true
a silver whistle she was given as a girl, before the singing started
_authoredWhy: SNG-661 §5. The banshee as a Threnodist story: the keener who sings deaths before they come. A person, grieving, so an NPC.
